items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos. An American bedroom wall showing two pieces of furniture side by side for comparison: on the left a long low six-drawer dresser in warm white oak (about 60 inches wide, 30 inches tall) with a round mirror hung above it, on the right a tall narrow five-drawer chest of drawers in the same oak (about 32 inches wide, 48 inches tall). Simple brass knobs, a lamp and a small plant on the dresser, light wood floor, soft daylight. Clean and calm.

items.name: 02-dresser
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos. A wide low dresser with two columns of three drawers in a soft white finish against a pale wall in an American primary bedroom, a large mirror leaning above it, a ceramic lamp and a tray with a perfume bottle on top, the corner of a bed with linen bedding at the edge of the frame. Daylight.

items.name: 03-chest
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos. A tall narrow chest of drawers with five stacked drawers in walnut, standing on a narrow wall between a window and a closet door in a small American bedroom, a small framed print above it and a basket beside it, wood floor, soft light. The chest takes little floor space.
